description: Save a movie JSON as a reusable template in the user's account (create, or update when template_id is given). Put default values in the movie's "variables" object and reference them with {{name}} placeholders. Once saved, render many videos with render_video using template_id + variables. The template also works from n8n, Make, Zapier and the API, and opens in the visual editor (editor_url). Use it for batches: design one video, save it as a template, then render each row of data by passing only variables.

movie.description: Complete movie JSON as a string, with a "variables" block of defaults and {{variable}} placeholders

name.description: Template name (required when creating a new template)

template_id.description: Existing template ID to update. Omit to create a new template

name: save_template
title: Save template
